title: Nonaxisymmetric Stability of Extremal Kerr Waves
exact_target: Does the known horizon-inclusive decay of axisymmetric waves on an extremal Kerr black hole extend to waves without rotational symmetry?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002146 (OWR-12009-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/37, pp. 2269--2333. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 30, 31.
Aretakis, axisymmetric waves on extreme Kerr (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Dafermos--Rodnianski--Shlapentokh-Rothman, subextremal Kerr stability (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The decay rate was recovered from the primary report (PDF page 30); the data norm and time-foliation conventions remain those of that estimate. Its target is decay of the scalar itself, and known transverse-derivative instabilities are a separate phenomenon.
